entities.summary: Eastern Galicia under Austrian rule became the centre of Ukrainian national life (the 'Ukrainian Piedmont'): the Greek Catholic Church, the Shevchenko Scientific Society, Ukrainian political parties, and the vibrant cultural life that the tsarist ban on Ukrainian language made impossible in Russian
